english.note: Use 唔協調 when colours, styles, or parts clash or do not match.
Use this especially when colours, shapes, designs, or other elements fail to harmonize.

examples.english: Her orange jacket and purple trousers are really jarring.
examples.traditional: 佢件橙色外套同條紫色褲好唔協調。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 caang2 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 tiu4 zi2 sik1 fu3 hou2 m4 hip3 tiu4

examples.english: These two colours look incongruous together.
examples.traditional: 呢兩隻色擺埋一齊好唔協調。
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zek3 sik1 baai2 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 m4 hip3 tiu4
